register_map.notes: SPI uses 1-byte register addressing with multi-byte bit for burst.

access_model.notes: SPI: first byte contains R/W bit, MB bit, and 6-bit register address. Data follows.

transaction.notes: SPI read command: R/W=0, MB=0, address=0x00. Read 1 byte.
Write POWER_CTL: clear measure bit to ensure standby.
Write DATA_FORMAT: full resolution, ±16g range (FULL_RES=1, Range=11).

steps.notes: Set data format: full resolution, ±16g range.

transaction.notes: Write BW_RATE: rate code 0x0A = 100 Hz, normal power.

steps.notes: Set output data rate to 100 Hz.

transaction.notes: Write POWER_CTL: set measure bit (D3) to enter measurement mode.

steps.notes: Wait for first data at 100 Hz ODR: turn-on time ~11.1 ms.

transaction.notes: SPI read command: R/W=1, MB=1, address=0x32. Read 6 bytes (X0, X1, Y0, Y1, Z0, Z1).

steps.notes: Burst read all six data registers.

operation_flows.notes: Read acceleration data via burst read.

preconditions: FIFO mode enabled and FIFO not empty

transaction.notes: Burst read 6 bytes to pop one FIFO sample.

steps.notes: Wait at least 5 µs between FIFO reads for SPI >1.6 MHz.

operation_flows.notes: Read FIFO data one sample at a time.

preconditions: Measurement mode active, data rate 100-800 Hz or 3200 Hz, normal power

steps.notes: Configure for self-test: full-res, 16g, self-test off.

transaction.notes: Read and average several samples (e.g., 10) with self-test off.
Set SELF_TEST bit (D7) to enable self-test.

steps.notes: Wait for output to settle (about 4 samples at 100 Hz = 40 ms).

transaction.notes: Read and average several samples with self-test on.
Clear SELF_TEST bit to disable self-test.

preconditions: Measurement mode active, device oriented in known position (e.g., z-axis vertical)

transaction.notes: Read and average samples to get X0g, Y0g, Z+1g.

steps.notes: Compute offset register values: XOFFSET = -Round(X0g/4), etc.

operation_flows.notes: Single-point offset calibration using offset registers.

raw_encoding.notes: Data registers are 16-bit twos complement, LSB first. In full resolution, scale factor is 4 mg/LSB regardless of range.

It is recommended to configure the device in standby mode before enabling measurement.

conversion_formulae.name: accel_conversion
conversion_formulae.formula: accel_g = (raw * scale_factor) / 1000, where scale_factor depends on mode. In full resolution (FULL_RES=1), scale_factor = 4 mg/LSB. In 10-bit mode, scale_factor = 3.9 mg/LSB for ±2g, 7.8 for ±4g, 15.6 for ±8g, 31.2 for ±16g.

inputs.name: raw
inputs.description: 16-bit twos complement raw value from data registers (LSB first).

conversion_formulae.name: self_test_change
conversion_formulae.formula: X_ST = X_ST_ON - X_ST_OFF (in LSB). Convert to g by multiplying by scale factor.

inputs.name: X_ST_ON
inputs.description: Average X-axis output with self-test enabled (LSB).

inputs.name: X_ST_OFF
inputs.description: Average X-axis output with self-test disabled (LSB).

conversion_formulae.name: offset_calculation
conversion_formulae.formula: XOFFSET = -Round(X0g / 4). Offset register scale factor is 15.6 mg/LSB, independent of g-range.
conversion_formulae.notes: Canonicalized: exact compensation is preserved in formula/inputs, but the single-line integer expression was marked non-executable because it is too complex or not accepted by the safe expression evaluator.

power_states.description: Low power mode, LOW_POWER bit = 1. Reduced power at certain data rates (12.5-400 Hz).

evidence_spans.snippet: Table 19. Register Map
The DEVID register holds a fixed device ID code of 0xE5 (345 octal).
The THRESH_TAP register is eight bits and holds the threshold value for tap interrupts. The scale factor is 62.5 mg/LSB
The OFSX, OFSY, and OFSZ registers are each eight bits and offer user-set offset adjustments in twos complement format with a scale factor of 15.6 mg/LSB
The DUR register is eight bits and contains an unsigned time value... The scale factor is 625 µs/LSB.
The latent register is eight bits and contains an unsigned time value... The scale factor is 1.25 ms/LSB.
The window register is eight bits and contains an unsigned time value... The scale factor is 1.25 ms/LSB.
The THRESH_ACT register is eight bits and holds the threshold value for detecting activity. The scale factor is 62.5 mg/LSB.
The THRESH_INACT register is eight bits and holds the threshold value for detecting inactivity. The scale factor is 62.5 mg/LSB.
The TIME_INACT register is eight bits and contains an unsigned time value... The scale factor is 1 sec/LSB.
The THRESH_FF register is eight bits and holds the threshold value... The scale factor is 62.5 mg/LSB.
The TIME_FF register is eight bits and stores an unsigned time value... The scale factor is 5 ms/LSB.
